ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Employee__r.Accrual_Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Employee__r.Accrual_Divisor__c)), Employee__r.Accrual_Divisor__c > 0, ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved") ), Absence_Hours__c > ( Employee__r.Total_Absence_Hours_Available__c + (Billable_Hours__c / Employee__r.Accrual_Divisor__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The employee does not have enough available absence hours to submit or approve this timesheet.
